role: EXPERIMENTAL RESEARCH - ground-level PV condition/defect detector, SECOND STAGE (runs on panel crops from the ground panel detector)
production_disposition: KEEP SEPARATE - do not merge, deploy, or integrate into the production pipeline
base_model: yolo11n.pt (YOLO11n, COCO-pretrained, Ultralytics) - NOT any Solar AI model
panel_class: NOT a class - PANEL detection is the separate first stage

excluded_classes.hotspot: out of scope - requires a separate thermal/IR model; never inferred from RGB
excluded_classes.Defective: ambiguous - excluded (not present in the sources anyway)

electrical_damage_semantic_risk.detail: Every ELECTRICAL_DAMAGE annotation is S1's 'electrical-damage' class. The provenance audit found these boxes visually correspond to CELL CRACKS, not confirmed electrical failure. Labels were preserved unchanged (not relabelled). A high ELECTRICAL_DAMAGE score is NOT an electrical-fault diagnosis - it most likely reflects that cell cracks are crisp, well-localised visual features.

clean_semantic_limitation: CLEAN is trained only where the source carried explicit clean-region annotations. Absence of a defect detection is NOT proof that an image or panel is Clean. No CLEAN bounding boxes were fabricated.

dataset.provenance_warning: underlying images ultimately trace to Kaggle pythonafroz/solar-panel-images (licence Unknown). Do NOT redistribute / publish / use commercially / claim verified CC BY image rights.

training.overfitting: none - train and val losses both still decreasing at epoch 100; model is UNDERFIT

evaluation.protocol: Ultralytics YOLO.val(), imgsz=640, iou=0.50, on the leakage-clean split; local re-eval reproduced the Kaggle numbers exactly
evaluation.confusion_matrix: class-vs-class confusion minimal; dominant error is missed detections (FN -> background): CLEAN 0.50 / DUSTY 0.63 / BIRD_DROP 0.66 / PHYSICAL_DAMAGE 0.45 / ELECTRICAL_DAMAGE 0.43 missed.
evaluation.plots: datasets/ground_pv_research/condition/reports/plots/ (train curves + train & held-out-test confusion matrix / PR / F1)

real_world_qualitative.ground_truth: NONE - qualitative only, no accuracy/precision/recall/F1/mAP computed. Predictions are raw model outputs, not facts.

production_safety.files_modified_in_production: none (models/, services/, app.py, pages/, weights/manifest.json, v1.0.0 all untouched)
